177:t_1:654.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't go, $$ランカ$$! You can't go!」

178:t_000:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$翠の地球$$ group is here.」

178:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed. The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, $$ラー・カイラム$$, and $$プトレマイオス２$$ are here too.」

178:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they made it safely too.」

178:t_001:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「With this much firepower assembled...」

178:t_001:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We should be able to attack the Empire's capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

178:t_001:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll begin the operational meeting as soon as we rendezvous with the $$クォーター$$ and $$ダナン$$.」

182:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

182:t_1:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Major $$オズマ$$... Where was the place $$ミカゲ$$ mentioned?」

182:t_1:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
「A town in northern Eurasia... There used to be a prison run by the $$地球連邦$$ there. The entire town existed to support it.」

182:t_1:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「It's known as $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$... The Empire has built a terminal base there now.」

182:t_1:8.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are being held by $$新地球皇国$$.」

182:t_1:10.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ went ahead to investigate the area.」

182:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Major was originally a $$人革連$$ soldier. He's the ideal man for a mission in that area.」

182:t_1:13.en:
$n
「It looks like $$ミカゲ$$ was behind $$アルト$$'s nightmares.」

182:t_1:15.en:
$$甲児$$
「Obviously, he wanted to provoke $$アルト$$ into rescuing $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan.」

182:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then he'll use them for his own purposes again.」

182:t_1:17.en:
$$さやか$$
「But with $$ミカゲ$$'s powers, he should be able to get them out, even if $$サイデリアル$$ has them.」

182:t_1:18.en:
$n
「Is $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$'s security so tight that even he can't get past it...?」

182:t_1:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「Captain... Please authorize a separate team to act.」

182:t_1:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Me, $$宗介$$, and $n, along with $$ヒイロ$$, $$スザク$$, and the others...」

182:t_1:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We've had our eye on $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ for some time as one of the facilities holding people kidnapped from around the world.」

182:t_1:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「This is a good opportunity. We'll take it and use it as a foothold for our attack on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

182:t_1:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't underestimate me, $$アルト$$. I want to save $$ランカ$$ as much as you do.」

182:t_1:29.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$オズマ$$ already cleared it with the captains as part of our overall strategy.」

182:t_1:31.en:
$$木下$$
「Thank you, my future brother-in-law! We'll save $$ランカ$$-chan and $$シェリル$$ without fail!」

182:t_1:32.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Who are you calling your brother-in-law!?」

182:t_1:33.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then let's do this! We've got to make it work!」

182:t_1:34.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah, and we'll save everyone imprisoned there, along with $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan!」

182:t_1:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「The dignitaries who were in $$オーブ$$ may be held there too.」

182:t_1:36.en:
$n
「If we capture it, we might find out why $$サイデリアル$$ is kidnapping people.」

182:t_1:37.en:
$$アンディ$$
「We're tackling a huge operation right after meeting up!」

182:t_1:38.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Maybe Supreme Commander $$不動$$ sent us to $c because he saw this coming.」

182:t_1:40.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know. We'll save those two, so $$ミカゲ$$ can't keep having his way.」

182:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
(Hold on, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... I'll save you, I promise...)

182:t_1:45.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No, it's nothing. Let's give it our best, $$ユノハ$$.」

182:t_1:46.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「We're infiltrating an enemy base, so your invisibility will definitely come in handy, $$ユノハ$$.」

182:t_1:47.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「Yes...! When it does, I'll give it everything I've got.」

182:t_1:49.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Maybe it's the power of your love with $$ジン$$.」

182:t_1:50.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「Wh-when you put it like that... It's a little embarrassing...」

182:t_1:51.en:
$$モロイ$$
「That part of you hasn't changed.」

182:t_1:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
(The power of love... $$ミカゲ$$ said love and hate are two sides of the same coin...)

182:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
(But I can't imagine he'd try the same method again after it failed once...)

182:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
(I don't understand... What is he planning to do with $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$...?)

182:t_1:58.en: ～Inside the Imperial Capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$～

182:t_1:59.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...It seems that $$堕天翅$$ has appeared.」

182:t_1:60.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Strictly speaking, he's a being born from a $$堕天翅$$'s hatred. At least he's no enemy of mine.」

182:t_1:61.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Emotion becomes power... That's a feeling I don't understand.」

182:t_1:62.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you don't understand, keep your mouth shut. That shows off your emptiness better, doesn't it?」

182:t_1:64.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Understood, $$ストラウス$$. I have no intention of starting a pointless quarrel.」

182:t_1:65.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Where are you going, $$尸空#pilot$$? Are you running away?」

182:t_1:66.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'm heading into space... Is that a problem, $$ストラウス$$?」

182:t_1:69.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「If I don't understand, I'll find out for myself. I'll deploy $$鬼宿$$.」

182:t_1:70.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hmph... Let's see what you've got, $$ムリエル・ザ・ゲート$$...」

182:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Splendid work, $$ユノハ$$. I thoroughly enjoyed $$アクエリオン$$'s new finishing move.」

182:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「She's vanished already! And she's completely invisible!」
